ghostware.name: READY RIG
ghostware.text: At the start of each ICE Node, choose one PROGRAM in your deck and install it for free.

ghostware.name: LOW PROFILE
ghostware.text: Whenever you would gain TRACE, gain 1 less (minimum 0).

ghostware.name: REDLINER
ghostware.text: At the start of your turn, if your TRACE is 20 or more, gain 1 BW.

ghostware.name: PATIENT ZERO
ghostware.text: At the start of each encounter, INFECT 1 ROT on every ICE.

ghostware.name: SUBDERMAL PLATING
ghostware.text: At the start of each Node, gain 6 SHIELD that lasts the whole Node.

ghostware.name: NEURAL BUFFER
ghostware.text: +6 Max VITAE (and heal 6).

ghostware.name: EXPANDED MEMORY
ghostware.text: +1 RAM.

ghostware.name: OVERCLOCKED BUS
ghostware.text: +1 BW on the first turn of each encounter.

ghostware.name: SPARE SOCKET
ghostware.text: +1 CAP slot. Gain a random common CAP at the start of each corporation.

ghostware.name: DEAD MAN'S POCKET
ghostware.text: Once per turn, you may CACHE 1 card for free.

ghostware.name: MONEY MULE
ghostware.text: Your Extractors extract 25% more CRED (rounded up).

ghostware.name: SIGNAL BOOSTER
ghostware.text: You can see what's inside SIGNAL UNCLEAR Nodes before choosing them.

ghostware.name: SCRAMBLED ID
ghostware.text: The first TRACE strike in each corporation has no penalty (TRACE still drops to 20).

ghostware.name: BLACK MIRROR
ghostware.text: +1 BW every turn.

ghostware.name: BLEEDING EDGE
ghostware.text: +1 DRAW every turn.

ghostware.name: BURNOUT CHIP
ghostware.text: Your Icepicks have +2 STR.
ghostware.drawback: Whenever you take PULP damage, take 1 more.

ghostware.name: KILLSWITCH
ghostware.text: Once per Node, if VITAE would drop to 0, it drops to 1 instead.

ghostware.name: COLD STORAGE
ghostware.text: CACHED cards cost 1 less BW.

ghostware.name: RECYCLER
ghostware.text: Whenever a card is BURNED, gain 1 BW (once per turn).

ghostware.name: CHAOS ENGINE
ghostware.text: Whenever you play your 4th card in a turn, draw 1.

ghostware.name: LUCKY STRIKE
ghostware.text: Card rewards offer 4 cards instead of 3.

ghostware.name: FIRST CONTACT
ghostware.text: The first ICE you meet in each Node gets −2 STR.

ghostware.name: SLEEPER AGENT
ghostware.text: At the start of each corporation, add a random rare card to your deck.

ghostware.name: LONG MEMORY
ghostware.text: +2 RAM.
ghostware.drawback: Your first card each turn costs 1 more BW.

ghostware.name: SIXTH SENSE
ghostware.text: Draw 1 extra card on the first turn of each encounter.

ghostware.name: FIELD MEDIC
ghostware.text: At every SAFEHOUSE and DEAD DROP, heal 5 extra VITAE.

ghostware.name: STREET CRED
ghostware.text: Start each corporation with 30 CRED.

ghostware.name: PATCH CABLE
ghostware.text: Whenever you apply a PATCHWORK, heal 4 VITAE.

ghostware.name: HEARTH KEY
ghostware.text: At the start of each encounter, every WALL gets −1 STR.

ghostware.name: VOICE MIMIC
ghostware.text: Once per encounter, the first TRACE subroutine that would resolve fails.

ghostware.name: AD BLOCKER
ghostware.text: Bloatware the corporation INSERTs always goes to your discard pile, never your hand or draw pile.
